title: SwiftFabric
description: SwiftFabric – Speed, Simplicity, and Smooth Gameplay Redefined!
body:
**SwiftFabric – Speed, Simplicity, and Smooth Gameplay Redefined!**

*Are you tired of heavy modpacks slowing you down? Say goodbye to sluggish performance and hello to SwiftFabric! This lightweight, performance-focused modpack is designed to give you a silky-smooth Minecraft experience without compromising on quality of life features.*

*With SwiftFabric, you’ll get the best of both worlds: powerful optimizations to enhance performance on any system, and hand-picked QoL mods that make gameplay more seamless and enjoyable. Whether you're exploring, building, or taking on mobs, SwiftFabric keeps things fast, fluid, and fun.*

Key Features:

⚡ Performance Boosts: Enjoy high FPS with enhanced rendering, faster load times, and minimal lag.
🛠 Quality of Life Upgrades: From improved inventory management to better crafting tools, play your way, hassle-free.
🔧 Fully Customizable: Tailor SwiftFabric to suit your needs without bloat or unnecessary mods.
🚀 Optimized for Fabric: Built on the Fabric modloader, ensuring lightweight and flexible mod support.
Lightweight. Powerful. Swift.

If you feature SwiftFabric in your video, please give credit and link back to the Modrinth page! 

Please note that SwiftFabric only supports Minecraft 1.20.1. There will be no releases for versions 1.20.4 or any future versions like 1.21. If you're running any older or newer versions, SwiftFabric is not compatible. For the best experience, please ensure you are playing on Minecraft 1.20.1.
